verse.verse_1: The mutual rivalry for piling up of worldly things diverts you,
verse.verse_2: Until you visit the graves (i.e. till you die).
verse.verse_3: Nay! You shall come to know!
verse.verse_4: Again, Nay! You shall come to know!
verse.verse_5: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge (the end result of piling up, you would not have occupied yourselves in worldly things)
verse.verse_6: Verily, You shall see the blazing Fire (Hell)!
verse.verse_7: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!
verse.verse_8: Then, on that Day, you shall be asked about the delight (you indulged in, in this world)!
